name: HRTS 5600
title: Human Rights Practice Lab
description: Critical engagement with human rights issues, strategies, tactics, institutions, and law in a practical setting. Students work collaboratively on a project addressing a pressing human rights issue and refine skills integral to working in the human rights field. Skills include information gathering, ethical analysis, effective communication across diverse audiences, and creative problem-solving.
requirement_description: Open only to Human Rights 5th-Year M.A. students, instructor consent required.
